title: Maximum Number of Vowels in a Substring of Given Length
prompt: Given a string `s` and an integer `k`, return the maximum number of vowel letters (`'a'`, `'e'`, `'i'`, `'o'`, `'u'`) in any substring of `s` with length `k`.

examples.explanation: Any substring of length 2 contains 2 vowels.
"lee", "eet", and "ode" all contain 2 vowels, which is the maximum.

constraints: s consists of lowercase English letters
hints: Recounting vowels for every window of length k from scratch is O(n*k).
Use a fixed-size sliding window of length k and maintain a running vowel count as it slides.
When the window shifts right by one, add 1 if the new character is a vowel and subtract 1 if the character leaving the window was a vowel; track the max count seen.

solution.approach: Maintain a fixed-size window of length k with a running count of vowels inside it. Initialize the count from the first k characters. As the window slides one step at a time, increment the count if the entering character is a vowel and decrement it if the character leaving is a vowel. The maximum count observed across all window positions is the answer.
